findings.title: The found bearer becomes the recompense
findings.claim: The person whose pack contains the found object is made both the locus of responsibility and the living equivalent of the penalty.
findings.mechanism: The repeated j-z-y forms carry equivalent return and standing-in; the passive finding names the object-person contact, while the pack term locates that contact in the person's own portable sphere. The later proposal and refusal of substitution return through these focus carriers and make the relation operational.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence becomes perceptible as a rule that joins evidence, person, and consequence before the later custody dispute unfolds.
findings.containment: This retains the ordinary punitive recompense reading and does not claim that the focus alone defines a complete legal code, proves who placed the object, or turns the pack into a physical dwelling.
